Join an Interdisciplinary PhD Program at the GSMHS
Welcome to an academic community dedicated to cutting-edge research at the intersection of medicine, science, and technology. The Graduate School in Medical and Health Sciences (GSMHS) offers a wide range of opportunities for registered PhD students to advance their training and expand their professional networks within and outside academia.
Relevant Information
Guidelines and Regulations
PhD Guide
Institutes
UNIverse PhD module
Looking for a PhD Position?
Do you aim to become PhD student in health sciences at the University of Basel? Your first step is to find a PhD supervisor who guides you during the PhD project and studies. You may find a supervisor by applying to advertised PhD positions or contacting potential PhD supervisors directly.
The GSMHS itself does not offer funded positions. Many PhD students are supported by third-party funding tied to specific research projects. Alternatively, candidates may secure their own funding through external fellowships (to be applied for independently).
Joining GSMHS is possible once you've been registered at the University of Basel.
Applying for an Advertised PhD Position
We strongly encourage candidates to apply for advertised PhD positions. These opportunities are listed on the job portals of our affiliated institutes. Please follow the application instructions provided in each listing carefully.
Find a Supervisor
Identifying a potential supervisor is the first crucial step. We encourage you to explore our doctoral programs and browse the websites of our partner institutions to identify a research group and to find a supervisor that aligns with your interests.
Already registered as PhD student at the University of Basel?
When registered in one of these PhD subjects, you will join GSMHS.
Biomedical Engineering
Clinical Research
Epidemiology and Public Health
Infection Biology
Medical Ethics
Medicines Development
Nursing Science
Sport Science
Upon creating your PhD agreement, you will join one of our five PhD programs.
